issues.description: Method signature mismatch for messageOnRide(): the problem statement and template call sites expect a no-argument method messageOnRide() that returns a String (used in Main.java as r.messageOnRide()). The solution repository defines Rideable.messageOnRide(int speed) (takes an int parameter) and Pig/Seal implement that parameterized signature and return strings that include the speed. This mismatch will cause compilation errors for code that calls messageOnRide() with no arguments and also deviates from the specified API/expected output format.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the API consistent across all artifacts. Option A (preferred for this exercise): change the solution to match the specification — update Rideable to declare String messageOnRide() (no parameters) and modify Pig and Seal to implement the no-arg method returning the exact string format specified in the problem (e.g. "Riding on Pig Doodle"). Update any tests/examples in the solution accordingly. Option B: if a speed parameter is intended, update the problem statement, UML, and the template Main to require messageOnRide(int speed) and change example usages (and the expected output in the exercise description) to include and document the speed parameter.
